prediction.headline: No clear direction yet: the desk expects movement but cannot tell which way

why: NIFTY is at 25,884, up 65 points (+0.25%) from yesterday's close of 25,819.
This morning it opened 54 points higher than yesterday's close and has hardly moved since.

India VIX, the market's 'fear gauge', is 16.9 (down 5% since yesterday: traders expect smaller moves than before). That points to a normal, lively market: NIFTY could move about 275 points up or down over the whole day.
Big news for the whole market today: Indian bonds tumble as Brent tops $95 per barrel, RBI flags food inflation risks.
Also: our forecast team's view is positive.
NIFTY has not moved enough this morning (less than about 0.15%) to pick a side.
plan: At 10:00 the desk buys two contracts on NIFTY for this week: a call, which makes money if NIFTY rises, and a put, which makes money if it falls. A big enough move either way pays more than the two cost together. It does not tilt the pair either way. It takes profit at +50%, cuts the loss at -35%, and closes everything by 15:15. All trades are on paper.
